import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    g = params[0] + params[1]*np.sqrt(t) + params[2]/np.sqrt(t) + params[3]*np.exp(-t) + params[4]*t*np.log(t) + params[5]*np.log(t)
    h = params[6]*(1-np.exp(-params[7]*t)) + params[8]*np.exp(-params[9]*t)
    return g + h*A**2
